run_deformable_torus_simulation: run the pybullet reduced deformable torus simulation in GUI mode with two torus objects
load_deformable_urdf_models: load reduced torus URDF models into a pybullet physics simulation with custom positions
apply_texture_to_visual_shape: apply a texture to a pybullet visual shape using changeVisualShape with rgbaColor and textureUniqueId
configure_sparse_sdf_voxel_size: configure the sparse SDF voxel size parameter for the pybullet physics engine
step_simulation_and_capture_camera: step the pybullet simulation loop and capture camera images at 320x200 resolution
